SELECT week_ending_date, count(*) AS n_rows, count(DISTINCT (store_key, product_key)) AS n_keys, count(DISTINCT etl_loaded_at) AS loads, min(etl_loaded_at) AS min_load, max(etl_loaded_at) AS max_load, sum(closing_value) AS val
FROM fact_stock_week WHERE week_ending_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-02-23' AND DATE '2026-03-22' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH w AS (SELECT * FROM fact_stock_week WHERE week_ending_date = DATE '2026-03-08'),
d AS (SELECT store_key, product_key FROM w GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING count(*)>1)
SELECT w.etl_loaded_at, count(*) AS n, count(DISTINCT w.store_key) AS stores, sum(closing_units) AS units, sum(closing_value) AS val,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM w w2 WHERE w2.etl_loaded_at = w.etl_loaded_at) AS total_in_load
FROM w JOIN d USING (store_key, product_key) GROUP BY w.etl_loaded_at ORDER BY 1

SELECT s.store_id, s.store_name, s.region, s.format, s.is_current, s.valid_from, s.valid_to, c.region AS cur_region,
 (SELECT count(DISTINCT w.product_key) FROM fact_stock_week w WHERE w.store_key=s.store_key AND w.week_ending_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-02-23' AND DATE '2026-03-22') AS prods
FROM dim_store s JOIN dim_store c ON c.store_id=s.store_id AND c.is_current
WHERE c.region='West' OR s.region='West' ORDER BY 1, s.valid_from

SELECT count(*) AS n, sum(CASE WHEN closing_units<0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS neg_units, sum(CASE WHEN closing_units IS NULL OR closing_value IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nulls,
 sum(CASE WHEN abs(closing_value - closing_units*p.standard_unit_cost) > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS value_mismatch,
 count(DISTINCT p.category) AS cats, sum(CASE WHEN p.category='ZZ Test' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS zz
FROM fact_stock_week f JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
WHERE f.week_ending_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-02-23' AND DATE '2026-03-22' AND s.region='West'

WITH params AS (SELECT DATE '2026-02-23' AS start_date, DATE '2026-03-22' AS end_date),
dedup AS (
    -- one row per store version x product version x week; the reloaded week 2026-03-08 holds identical repeats
    SELECT store_key, product_key, week_ending_date,
           arg_max(closing_units, etl_loaded_at) AS closing_units,
           arg_max(closing_value, etl_loaded_at) AS closing_value
    FROM fact_stock_week, params
    WHERE week_ending_date BETWEEN params.start_date AND params.end_date
    GROUP BY store_key, product_key, week_ending_date
),
weekly AS (
    SELECT cp.category, d.week_ending_date, SUM(d.closing_value) AS closing_value
    FROM dedup d
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = d.store_key
    JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = s.store_id AND cs.is_current
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = d.product_key
    JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
    WHERE cs.region = 'West' AND s.store_id < 900 AND cp.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT category, ROUND(AVG(closing_value), 2) AS avg_weekly_closing_stock_value, COUNT(*) AS weeks
FROM weekly GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

calls.statement:
WITH dedup AS (
    SELECT store_key, product_key, week_ending_date, arg_max(closing_value, etl_loaded_at) AS v
    FROM fact_stock_week WHERE week_ending_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-02-23' AND DATE '2026-03-22' GROUP BY 1,2,3),
direct AS (
    SELECT d.week_ending_date, SUM(d.v) AS v FROM dedup d JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=d.store_key WHERE s.region='West' GROUP BY 1)
SELECT (SELECT AVG(v) FROM direct) AS avg_total_direct, (SELECT count(*) FROM dim_product WHERE is_current) AS cur_rows, (SELECT count(DISTINCT sku) FROM dim_product WHERE is_current) AS cur_skus
